name: scorekin
description: Board game collection, play log and stats for ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Scorekin keeps track of your board game collection and the games you play with friends, right in the conversation.

- Collection: add games you own, want or have sold, with ratings, tags, notes and who borrowed what.
- Play log: say “We played Azul, I scored 72, Anna 65” and Scorekin records the play, the scores and the winner.
- Stats: plays per month, most-played games, win rates against each friend, streaks and milestones.
- Suggestions: “What should four of us play in an hour?” picks from your own shelf.
- Import from BoardGameGeek by username, and export everything as JSON at any time.

Sign in with a Scorekin account (email and password). Your data is private to your account and you can delete it from ChatGPT at any time. Game covers come from Wikipedia and may be missing for some games.
defaultPrompt: We played Azul: I scored 72, Anna 65.
What should four of us play in about an hour?

positive.description: Show the collection as a grid of owned games
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the owned games of the test account (Wingspan, Azul, Brass: Birmingham and others) as a grid with covers, player counts, playtime and play counts.

positive.description: Log a play with scores in natural language
positive.prompt: We just played Azul. I scored 78 and Anna scored 64.
positive.expected_behavior: Records a play of Azul dated today with two players, marks the user as the winner, and shows a confirmation card with the scores.

positive.description: Suggest games from the user's own shelf
positive.prompt: What should we play tonight? There are four of us and about an hour.
positive.expected_behavior: Suggests owned games that support four players and fit about an hour, with a short reason for each pick.

positive.prompt: Show my board game stats for this year.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows totals for the current year: number of plays, hours played, most-played games, plays per month and win rates against frequent opponents.

positive.description: Show one game with its play history
positive.prompt: How have my Wingspan games gone?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows Wingspan with the number of plays, the user's wins, the highest score and the most recent plays.

negative.description: Buying a game is out of scope: Scorekin does not sell anything
negative.prompt: Buy me a copy of Ark Nova.

negative.description: A question unrelated to board games should not call Scorekin
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Berlin tomorrow?

negative.description: Scorekin does not store contact details of other players

review.commerce_description: Scorekin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: collection, play log, stats, suggestions, BoardGameGeek import and data export.

ru-RU.subtitle: Настолки, партии и статистика
ru-RU.description:
Scorekin ведёт вашу коллекцию настольных игр и историю партий прямо в разговоре.

- Коллекция: игры, которые есть, хочется или уже проданы, с оценками, тегами, заметками и тем, кому что одолжено.
- Партии: скажите «Сыграли в Азул, у меня 72, у Ани 65», и Scorekin запишет партию, очки и победителя.
- Статистика: партии по месяцам, самые частые игры, победы против каждого друга, серии и юбилеи.
- Подсказки: «Во что сыграть вчетвером за час?» — выбор из вашей полки.
- Импорт с BoardGameGeek по нику и выгрузка всех данных в JSON.

Вход через аккаунт Scorekin (email и пароль). Данные видны только вам, удалить их можно прямо из ChatGPT.
